My dear[Gertrude](/person/1462)
Thank you for your letter, which I found here when I arrived yesterday, by way of Salisbury and Basingstoke. I meant all those flowers of which there was but one specimen for you, [Helen](/person/1613) may wait to collect for herself
Your most affectionate

C M Yonge
